args.summary:
Model built and verified for a cast-in-place continuous prestressed concrete single-cell box girder bridge, 30+45+30 m, deck width 12.5 m.

Idealization/system: spine_beam_2d, system = continuous_on_piers (pier columns modeled since column geometry is given).

Section/material: cast_box section integrated to A = 7.05 m², I = 4.7775 m⁴; C55 concrete Ec = 35500 MPa (JTG 3362-2018 3.1.5); γ = 26.0 kN/m³ (JTG D60-2015 4.2.1); w = 183.3 kN/m; m = 18.685 t/m (girder self-weight only).

Bearings (laminated elastomeric, Ge = 1.2 MPa from manufacturer): Support 0 & 3 abutments — PTFE sliding, 2 per line, 400×500, 5 layers → S=10.10, Kv=3.614e6 kN/m, Kh=0. Pier 1 — plain fixed, 600×700, 7 layers → S=14.69, Kv=8.974e6, Kh=13091 kN/m. Pier 2 — PTFE sliding, 550×650, 6 layers → S=13.54, Kv=8.075e6, Kh=0. Piers: twin 1.4 m circular C40 columns (Ec=32500 MPa); Pier 1 h=6 m, Pier 2 h=29 m; A=3.079 m², I=0.3771 m⁴ each.

Live load: Class I, one-way, 3 design lanes, qk=10.5 kN/m, Pk=320/350/320 kN (spans 1/2/3), transverse factor ξ=0.78.

Modal analysis: f1 = 3.239 Hz → impact factor μ = 0.192 (JTG D60-2015 4.3.2).

Results (all L1/L2/L3 checks passed): vertical frequencies 3.239 / 5.934 / 6.555 Hz; self-weight support reactions 1811 / 7843 / 7735 / 1858 kN; self-weight mid-span moments 6546 / 18945 / 7244 kN·m; support moments −28150 / −26755 kN·m; lane-load max positive moment 11254 kN·m, max negative −8975 kN·m.

No unresolved problems.
